subject: Remove Google-internal specifics and unused code (#136)
reason: The change is a pure cleanup with no behaviour change: it removes Google-internal comment references (a screenshot link and Buganizer bug numbers in TODOs), deletes dead declarations (SchemaManager::OnSavingStarted/OnSavingEnded have no definitions, callers, or server-event subscriptions anywhere in the tree), and deletes Google-internal metadata and Bazel files (METADATA, OWNERS, copy.bara.sky, blueprint, redis_module_*.bzl) that the open-source CMake build never references.
